title: 第11章 我是好人第12章 速生灵散
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
一头绿毛的小青年脸都绿了。
刚才的赵大柱，明明给人一种垂垂老矣的感觉。
可是现在，赵大柱足以用龙精虎猛来形容！
刚好旁边有半截砖头，绿毛小青年于是一把抓起砖头，朝着赵大柱砸了过去。
哪知道赵大柱就好像后脑勺长了眼睛，他突然转身一把就将飞过来的半截砖头抓在手里，并咔嚓一声捏的粉碎！
看到这一幕，绿毛小青年人都傻了。
“跑啊！这老东西不是人，他是妖怪！”
绿毛小青年发出一连串惊恐的怪叫，而且扭头就跑。
那些小混混也不敢再和赵大柱纠缠了，一个个撒丫子狂奔，狼狈的朝着巷子的出口方向逃窜，宛如一群遭到驱赶的流浪狗。
他们甚至都不敢回头看一眼赵大柱。
而那个黄毛精神小妹，此刻也已经彻底慌了神。
“等等我，你们等等我！”
精神小妹带着哭腔大喊，追赶那群小混混，可是她才刚跑出去几步就被一块砖头绊倒，噗通一声摔在地上。
等她抬起头来，两行鲜红的鼻血就从鼻孔里流出，一下子就将她的上嘴唇染的通红。
“你刚才不是很嚣张吗，你再嚣张一个给我看看？”
赵大柱笑呵呵的走了过来，挡在了这个精神小妹的面前，这样一来她就是再想逃跑也办不到了。
“大……大爷，我错了，我不敢了……”
精神小妹哭着说道，不仅眼圈泛红，晶莹的眼泪也从眼眶里溢出来了，宛如断了线的珠子从她那沾满泥土的脸颊上滑落。
赵大柱呵呵一笑接着说道：“我觉得你下次还敢。”
“我真的不敢了……我怕了你了……”精神小妹哭唧唧的说道。

“我总不能就这么放过你吧？你都带人报复我了，我要是不教训你，那我的脸往哪里搁？”赵大柱意味深长的说道，而且抬起手作势欲打。
这个精神小妹顿时就发出了凄厉的悲鸣：“救命……救命啊……杀人了……”
赵大柱顿时就一脸懵。
他只是想吓唬一下这个精神小妹而已，却没料到这个死丫头的反应竟然如此剧烈。
她叫的这么大声，大街上的行人肯定能听的清清楚楚！
于是赵大柱下意识的就把手伸了过去，一把捂住了这个精神小妹的口鼻。
但已经来不及了。
一辆警车不知何时停在巷子口，一个国字脸中年男人和一个二十出头的年轻人一起从车上跳下。
他们都穿着黑色的警务署制服，腰间还别着对讲机和警棍——不用想也能知道他们肯定是警务署的人。
“住手！”
“放开那个女孩！”
这下轮到赵大柱尴尬了。
他做梦都没想到这个女孩的尖叫真的会把警务署的人吸引过来，而且警务署的人还来的这么快。
这简直就是秒出警！
“没听见我的话吗，把那个女孩放开！”
content_en:
The young man with green hair turned green.
The Zhao Dazhu just now clearly gave people the feeling of being old.
But now, Zhao Dazhu can be described as a dragon and a tiger!
There happened to be half a brick next to him, so the green-haired young man grabbed the brick and threw it towards Zhao Dazhu.
Unexpectedly, Zhao Dazhu seemed to have eyes on the back of his head. He suddenly turned around, grabbed the flying brick half in his hand, and crushed it with a click!
Seeing this scene, the green-haired young man was dumbfounded.
"Run! This old guy is not a human, he is a monster!"
The green-haired young man let out a series of frightened screams, turned around and ran away.
Those gangsters no longer dared to tangle with Zhao Dazhu, and they ran wildly one by one, fleeing toward the exit of the alley in embarrassment, like a group of driven stray dogs.
They didn't even dare to look back at Zhao Dazhu.
And that yellow-haired energetic girl was completely panicked at this moment.
"Wait for me, wait for me!"
The spirited girl yelled in a tearful voice and chased after the gangsters, but she tripped over a brick just a few steps away and fell to the ground with a thud.
When she raised her head, two lines of bright red nosebleeds flowed out of her nostrils, immediately turning her upper lip red.
"Weren't you very arrogant just now? Show me how arrogant you are again?"
Zhao Dazhu walked over with a smile and stood in front of this spirited girl. In this way, she couldn't escape even if she wanted to.
"Uncle...Uncle, I was wrong, I don't dare anymore..."
The spirit girl cried, not only her eye circles were red, but crystal tears also overflowed from her eyes, like broken beads sliding down her earth-covered cheeks.
Zhao Dazhu chuckled and continued: "I think you will be brave next time."
"I really don't dare anymore...I'm scared of you..." the spirited girl said in tears.
"I can't just let you go, can I? You have brought people to take revenge on me. If I don't teach you a lesson, then where will I put my face?" Zhao Dazhu said meaningfully, and raised his hand to strike.
This spirited girl immediately let out a shrill scream: "Help...help...killer..."
Zhao Dazhu suddenly looked confused.
He just wanted to scare this spirited girl, but he didn't expect this dead girl's reaction to be so violent.
She screamed so loudly that people on the street could hear her clearly!
So Zhao Dazhu subconsciously reached out his hand and covered the mouth and nose of this spirited girl.
But it was too late.
A police car stopped at the entrance of the alley at some point. A middle-aged man with a Chinese character and a young man in his early twenties jumped out of the car.
They were all wearing black police department uniforms, with walkie-talkies and batons strapped to their waists - it didn't take much to figure out that they must be from the police department.
"Stop!"
"Let that girl go!"
This time it was Zhao Dazhu's turn to be embarrassed.
He never dreamed that the girl's scream would actually attract people from the police station, and that the people from the police station would come so quickly.
This is like calling the police in seconds!
"Didn't you hear me? Let that girl go!"
